name: KUEPER Food Chemistry Thermal Process Canon

knowledgeDomains.title: Thermische Lebensmittelchemie - Zucker, Zersetzung und Braeunung

rules: Do not model a universal caramelization temperature as an invariant property of a sugar.
Separate observed crystal-structure-loss or DSC thermal events from thermal decomposition and caramelization chemistry.
Thermal reaction claims require temperature and time context; advanced models should additionally represent matrix and water content.
Numeric onset values are evidence observations tied to sample form and method, not timeless canonical Concept properties.
SSF owns didactic presentation; KG owns canonical concept and KnowledgeDomain identities.
